post.description:
Creates an outbound voice campaign and schedules calls to the provided customers.

**Timezone handling:**
All time values (`startTime`, `endTime`, and `daySchedules` entries) are wall-clock times interpreted in the campaign's `timezone`. For example, `startTime: "09:00"` with `timezone: "Europe/Prague"` means 09:00 CET/CEST (depending on DST). See the [IANA timezone list](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones) for valid identifiers.

**Per-day schedule overrides:**
Use `daySchedules` to set different calling hours for specific days. Days not listed in `daySchedules` use the global `startTime`/`endTime` window. Days not in `activeDays` are inactive regardless of `daySchedules`.

post.summary: Cancel scheduled calls by phone number
post.description:
Cancels every scheduled (pending) call job for a customer phone number across all of the workspace's campaigns — queued retries after no-answer as well as agent-scheduled callbacks.

Built for the "customer called us back" flow: when a customer you were going to call (or call again) reaches you first, cancel the now-redundant scheduled call. Typically invoked from an inbound workflow's API-call action or from your backend when an inbound contact is handled.

**Phone number matching:** the number is matched independent of spelling — international (`+905321234567`), bare country code (`905321234567`), and national (`05321234567`) forms all find the same customer. Calls already in progress are not affected.

Cancelled customers get the final outcome `canceled` with dropout reason `customer_called_back` in campaign results and exports. The response reports how many jobs were cancelled; zero matches is a success, not an error.

post.description:
Sent to the campaign's webhookUrl when a call completes or fails.

**Payload Types:**
- **WebhookCallOutcome**: Sent when a call completes (success or failure with ended_reason)
- **WebhookApiError**: Sent when call initiation fails before a call is created

**Failure Categories:**
- `no_answer`: Customer didn't answer
- `busy`: Line was busy
- `voicemail`: Reached voicemail
- `timeout`: Call timed out (infrastructure)
- `api_error`: API call failed before call started
- `llm_fail`: LLM evaluation failed (if successPrompt configured)
- `other`: Unknown failure

**Retry Behavior:**
- If `willRetry: true`, check `retryScheduledAt` for next attempt time
- Retries respect the campaign's schedule (activeDays, startTime, endTime, and daySchedules overrides)
- `retriesRemaining` shows how many retries are left

post.description: Queues a lossless dump of calls + related sub-tables + recordings + debug blobs + upstream FK targets (agents/workflows/versions) for round-trip with the import endpoint. The selection is frozen at request time and the ZIP is generated by the export worker: poll `GET /export/{jobId}` and collect it from `GET /export/{jobId}/download` (only the requesting account can collect a raw bundle). The ZIP contains calls.json, agents.json, workflows.json, versions.json, recordings/<callId>[_user|_assistant].{opus,mp3,wav}, and traces/<callId>.json.gz + logs/<callId>.json.gz (gzip-compressed OTel traces and application logs, management only). Workspace-scoped; requires the `calls:export` permission.

post.summary: Import calls from a raw ZIP export
post.description: Accepts a multipart/form-data upload of a ZIP archive produced by /call/export-raw. Phase A inserts bundled workflows/agents/versions (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, flagged is_imported) so imported calls preserve their call → agent → workflow → version FK chain inside the target workspace. Phase B creates calls (flagged is_imported), uploads recordings to the target workspace S3 path, and inserts related tags/feedbacks/assertion results. Workspace-scoped; requires the `calls:import` permission.

Returns every property a widget can be built from: built-in call and customer attributes plus the workspace's insight fields, in one namespace.

Each entry declares the slots it may fill (`dimension`, `measure`, `filter`, `stage`), the aggregations it supports, and whether projecting it at row grain requires `calls:pii`. Insight fields are keyed by id, so two fields sharing a name stay distinct; `labelHint` carries the agent name in that case.

post.description: Creates a new custom role. The actor can only grant permissions they themselves hold; `workspace:delete` cannot be assigned to a custom role.

403.description: Workspace ID mismatch or insufficient permissions

409.description: Role name already exists in this workspace

patch.description: Updates a custom role. System roles (Owner / Admin / Member) reject this with 409. Permission changes (additions or removals) take effect immediately, on each affected member's next request.

403.description: Workspace ID mismatch or insufficient permissions

404.description: Role not found in this workspace

409.description: Cannot edit a system role, or name conflict

delete.description: Deletes a custom role. System roles, the workspace's default role, and roles with assigned members all reject with 409.

403.description: Workspace ID mismatch or insufficient permissions

409.description: Cannot delete a system role, the default role, or one with members
